description.value: Eat Pure Mountain Market is Golden's organic grocer since 2014, founded by holistic chef Nicole Du Vent and stocked with fresh produce, dairy, grass-fed and free-range meat, baking essentials, natural body care, and supplements. The in-store Hive Cafe serves organic lunches, smoothies, coffee, and vegan and gluten-free treats, making it a substantive resupply stop for cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley on the Trans-Canada corridor. The store is community-rooted, sourcing pork, eggs, and garlic from the owners' own permaculture farm.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active organic grocery store at 824 10th Ave S #101, Golden, BC with phone (250) 939-9532. The Hive Cafe section confirms prepared food service (organic lunch, smoothies, coffee). No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site; OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is noted but WiFi is not a checklist item.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Unknown / Kootenays' but Golden, BC is in the Columbia Valley / East Kootenay region — minor geographic classification issue.
Two different email addresses appear on the website: EATPUREMOUNTAINMARKET@GMAIL.COM on the contact page and EATPUREFOOD@GMAIL.COM in the site footer.
OSM record has no phone or address fields; both sourced from website only so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address cannot be cross-checked.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established organic grocery store with an in-house cafe in Golden, BC — a natural and well-stocked resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor through the Columbia Valley.
